description: Flat vector sticker style for Slack-style emoji packs: bold simple shapes, limited palette, transparent background, no animation language.

prompt_blocks.house_style: Flat vector sticker style: bold simple shapes, thick consistent outlines, limited 4-6 colour palette, flat fills with at most one shadow step, transparent background, square aspect ratio, no gradients, no photorealism, no fine detail that disappears at 128x128. Readable as a single emoji-sized icon.

forbidden_artifacts: Sticker must read as a single iconic shape; do not draw multiple disconnected motifs in one cell.
Do not include text, captions, watermarks, frame numbers, signatures, or UI chrome.
Do not draw scenery, backgrounds, gradients, photorealistic shading, or soft transparency.
Do not use the chroma-key colour or chroma-adjacent colours in the sticker, outline, or shadow.
